did: Built the interview week's measured faults as a pure, tested module in a new workspace, packages/ui/interview-week. For an interview answer it counts fillers, pauses, the silence before and after, mumbled words, pace and length against the question's target. For a teleprompter read it lines the words up against the card's script and counts words skipped, swapped, repeated and added, pauses at a break against pauses mid-phrase, how even the pace was, and the lead-in. It also types the half the model fills: STAR, hedges, and a decision's options, why, trade-off and undo. Settled the filler list with home's transcriber (IW2): fourteen words, owned here, at most one per heard word.

calls.title: How long a gap is a pause
options: 2 s in an answer and half a second in a read, a gap at the threshold counting
calls.why: A phrasing pause at a comma is far shorter than a lost thread, and whisper's timings drift by a couple of hundred milliseconds (C263).

calls.title: When a word counts as mumbled
options: whisper less than half sure of it, words without a probability left out
the same, counting them as heard
calls.why: Under one half the transcriber was less sure of the word than not (C264).

calls.title: Which sounds count as fillers
options: fourteen vocalised hesitations, at most one per heard word
those plus like, you know, so, basically
a short four: um, uh, er, ah
calls.why: Counting like or so by code would count their ordinary use too, which only judging can tell apart; err joined after IW2's real-model runs (C265).
calls.undo: Edit packages/ui/interview-week/src/lib/faults/fillers.json, then home's copy in file_host's transcribe/verbatim.rs.

calls.title: How a read is checked against its script
options: word alignment, a repeat within three words, pace variation over phrases of three or more words
a repeat only when it follows the same word
variation over fixed windows of time
calls.why: The script's own phrases are where a stiff read shows, and a restart repeats the last few words (C266).
calls.undo: Change REPEAT_WINDOW or MIN_PHRASE_WORDS in thresholds.ts, or read.ts's alignment rules.

left: Nothing reaches the module yet: the week's routine (IW4, #2935) and essay (IW6, #2937) are the stories that call it.
A script's 2 and a heard two still count as a substitution: words are compared as written.
